function.name: execute_python
function.description: Execute Python code and return the output. Use for calculations, data processing, or scripting tasks.

function.name: execute_shell
function.description: Execute a PowerShell or CMD command on the local system. Use for system management tasks.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read the contents of a file from the local filesystem.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the file

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file on the local filesystem.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the file

content.description: Content to write to the file

function.name: list_files
function.description: List files and directories in a given path.

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the web for information. Returns top 5 results with titles, snippets, and URLs.

function.name: set_reminder
function.description: Set a reminder for a specific time. E.V. will notify the user when it's time.

due_time.description: When to remind, in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS) or natural language like 'in 30 minutes', 'tomorrow at 9am'

function.name: get_reminders
function.description: Get a list of upcoming or pending reminders.

function.name: take_screenshot
function.description: Take a screenshot of the current screen or active window.

function.name: analyze_image
function.description: Analyze an image using AI vision. Can describe content, read text, identify objects.

image_path.description: Path to the image file to analyze

function.name: automate_app
function.description: Perform automation actions on the desktop: open apps, open web URLs, search/play music or videos on YouTube/Spotify, type text, click, press keys, control volume/windows.

action.description: The automation action to perform. Use 'play_media' to search/play songs or videos on YouTube/Spotify, 'open_url' for websites, 'open_app' for desktop software.

target.description: Target of the action (e.g., 'youtube', 'spotify', app name 'chrome', URL 'https://...', key name 'playpause', 'enter', coords 'x,y', etc.)

value.description: Additional parameter (e.g. song/video search query for play_media, search query for browser, text for type_text, volume 0-100 for set_volume)

function.name: remember_fact
function.description: Store an important fact or piece of information in long-term memory for future reference.

fact.description: The fact or information to remember

function.name: recall_facts
function.description: Search long-term memory for relevant information.

query.description: What to search for in memory
